summary: Add an accessible inline editor that reuses Todo field types, updates the existing item only after validation, and relies on the current todos persistence and filtering flow.
steps: Add task-specific edit controls and a single-task draft state initialized from the selected Todo.
Render labeled fields for title, notes, category, priority, and due date with explicit save and cancel actions.
Validate titles before updating the matching Todo while preserving id and completion state.
Style edit mode responsively and keep normal task actions unchanged outside edit mode.
Add automated tests for save, validation, cancel, persistence, and existing behaviors.
Run deterministic and Playwright evaluation and record evidence.
risks: Editing a field used by the active filter may make the task leave the current list immediately after save.
Draft values must not leak into local storage before save.
Inline form controls must remain usable on narrow screens and with assistive technology.
